notes: TypeSafe Jev vendor contract pin — the single source of truth for the model id and the strict request/response shapes. tests/judgment/contract.test.ts is the drift alarm: it asserts src/judgment constants AND zod schemas match this file exactly. Re-calibration ritual on drift: re-verify against docs.typesafe.ai/models.md (append .md for raw markdown), then update THIS file + src/judgment/schemas.ts + the client constants in one commit, then re-run the probe.
